page.overview:
Who is Belin?

Belin was a male Ugnaught pilot trapped in the Occlusion Zone after the destruction of Starlight Beacon. He piloted a transport ship, regularly shipping grain. While piloting his ship, the Ugnaught met Jedi Master Avar Kriss, who was trying to take over the ship to redirect the ship's cargo, a grain shipment, to the Rodian colony Prandril which was experiencing an extreme food shortage. Belin was reluctant at first thinking the idea of stealing from the Nihil was insane, later he grew into liking what he did with Kriss, feeling that he did something meaningful. After the skirmish above Seswenna he decided that, instead of fleeing from the Occlusion Zone with Kriss, that he would instead stay inside the zone with Rhil Dairo to report on the atrocities that the Nihil perpetrated.
